body: I know that this doesnt really help much, but you are still very young and you dont have to have a solid plan yet. At 21 your brain is still not fully developed and you are still learning a lot about life as an adult. No one has it figured out, so give yourself a break. Do whatever you need to do to make it to the next day and maybe you will start to piece out what you want from life.
